items.computation: This is a private invoice, so the period is counted under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB from the invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) as explicitly stated, not from delivery. Rechnungsdatum = 07.09.2026 (the event day, not counted per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB). A 14-day period starting the next day (08.09.2026) ends 14 days later on 21.09.2026. 21.09.2026 is a Monday (checking: 09.09.2026 is a Wednesday per given reference date, so 21.09.2026 = Wednesday + 12 days = Monday), not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW (the payer's Land, relevant for payments under §§ 269, 270 Abs. 4 BGB), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
